messages.軽い資源で戦闘序盤に撃ち、精神力が低い味方4人を回復して立ち上がりを安定させる、: A Pride Blunt E.G.O that hits 3 targets, costs few resources, and can be used early in a fight to restore SP to the 4 allies with the lowest SP and stabilize the opening.
messages.精神力の回復: 攻撃終了時に、精神力が最も低い味方4人の精神力を回復する(解析Ⅲ: **SP recovery**: At the end of the attack, restores SP to the 4 allies with the lowest SP, increased to 10 at Threadspin Ⅲ and 12 at Ⅳ.
messages.軽い必要資源: 暴食2・傲慢4、精神消耗は20。ZAYIN なので重いE.G.O: **Light requirements**: 2 Gluttony and 4 Pride, with a Sanity cost of 20. As a ZAYIN E.G.O, it can be used earlier than heavier E.G.O.
messages.広域攻撃: 攻撃加重値3で、マッチ威力は15~19(解析Ⅲで19~23)。傲慢抵: **Multi-target attack**: 3 Attack Weight, with Clash Power of 15–19, or 19–23 at Threadspin Ⅲ. Note that her resistances change to Endured against Pride and Fatal to Lust and Gluttony.
messages.パッシブ「倦怠」: 攻撃中に敵が混乱すると、精神力が最も低い味方1名の次のターン: **Passive — Ennui**: If an enemy is staggered during the attack, the 1 ally with the lowest SP gains +2 SP Heal Efficiency next turn, up to 3 times per turn. The condition is strict, so treat it as a minor extra.
messages.侵蝕なし: 初期E.G.Oなので侵蝕スキルは無い。: **No Corrosion**: As a starting E.G.O, it has no Corrosion skill.
messages.精神力が下がる序盤に撃ち、味方のマッチを安定させる。: Use it early, when SP is dropping, to stabilize allies' Clashes.
messages.打撃や傲慢に弱い敵なら、攻撃目的で撃ってもよい。: Against enemies weak to Blunt or Pride, it can also be used for damage.
messages.回復はスキル単発で完結するので、パッシブの発動は期待しすぎない。: The healing is complete with a single use, so do not count on the passive triggering.
messages.Ⅱ: パッシブ「倦怠」が解放されるだけで、実質的な変化は小さい。: **Ⅱ**: Only unlocks the passive Ennui, so the practical change is small.
messages.Ⅲ: マッチ威力が上がり、回復量が10になる。: **Ⅲ**: Raises Clash Power and increases the heal to 10.
messages.Ⅳ: 回復量が12になるだけで、優先度は低いと考えられる。: **Ⅳ**: Only increases the heal to 12, so it is likely a low priority.
messages.LCB囚人: スキルが傲慢・怠惰・暴食で、必要資源の傲慢と暴食を自分で出せる。: **[LCB Sinner](persona:0201)**: Her skills are Pride, Sloth, and Gluttony, so she can supply the required Pride and Gluttony herself.
messages.ロボトミーE.G.O::後悔: S2が傲慢で、重い傲慢4の資源を補える。: **[Lobotomy E.G.O::Regret](persona:0207)**: Her Pride S2 helps cover the heavy 4 Pride requirement.
